description: BWI Airport Shuttle Stops is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Layer of BWI Shuttle Bus stops for all five shuttles. Bus stops are located at airport, parking lots and amtrak station. Created by CMRT. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are public transportation, queen anne's, regional transportation agency, ride on, routes. The table has 5 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
